Persistent failures do not establish that humanity lacked an adequate methodology, just as a successful demonstration does not establish a generally dependable one. limitations: The empirical study covers a sample of practitioners and systems.

statement.excerpt: The fourth thing to realize is that we, and by this I mean humanity as a whole, still don’t really have an adequate methodology for building complex cognitive systems.
statement.document_title: Dear Elon Musk, here are five things you might want to consider about AGI

our_interpretation: An adequate methodology means a repeatable engineering approach for building and modifying integrated cognitive systems with dependable behavior and manageable regressions.
Adequacy does not require eliminating every bug. Conversely, a successful isolated model does not establish a generally adequate integration methodology.
The context concerns perception, reasoning, planning and action working together, including autonomous vehicles.
The current observation window is calendar 2022 through May 31 because the research field has no regular reporting cycle; earlier methods are context.
criteria.support_condition: Broad contemporary evidence shows that available engineering approaches cannot reliably manage integration and modification of complex cognitive systems across relevant applications.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A publicly documented, repeatable methodology had demonstrated dependable construction and modification of such systems across relevant applications by May 2022.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A defined reliability standard and comparative evidence showing whether contemporary methods could repeatedly build, modify and maintain representative integrated cognitive systems to that standard.
